explanation: For each level of a perfect tree, follow the already established next links. Connect each left child to its right sibling and each right child to the next parent’s left child. Move down the leftmost path to begin the next level.
timeComplexity: O(n) time for the perfect-tree contract.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary linking space, excluding the wrapper’s level output.
